description: This PHP class, NucleiOutputProcessor, processes output files generated by Nuclei vulnerability scanner. It reads JSON lines from a specified file, parses vulnerability details, and converts them into internal Vulnerability objects linked to host assets.

classes.name: NucleiOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes Nuclei scan output JSON lines, extracting vulnerability information and mapping them to assets and internal data structures.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads a file containing JSON lines from a Nuclei scan, parses each line to extract vulnerability details, and returns a ProcessorResult containing all vulnerabilities found.
